title: Rewrite Like Leo
prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it sounds like a software engineer talking plainly to a teammate.

Rules:
- Short sentences, short paragraphs. Lead with what happened or what's needed.
- Use "we" for the team and "I" for my own work and opinions. State opinions with the reason right after.
- Numbered lists for changes, asks and discussion points.
- One hedge at most per claim. No corporate or marketing tone.
- No em dashes. No words like delve, robust, seamless, crucial, comprehensive, leverage, enhance, additionally.
- Keep every fact, ticket ID and link. Don't add new claims.

Output only the rewritten text.
